ProductTour.step_1_body: We'll show you exactly how to go from browsing to landing at an Indian university in a few quick steps.
ProductTour.step_2_body: This is the full path from first inquiry to arriving in India. Every student who works with us follows these steps.
ProductTour.step_3_body: Browse our partner universities, compare programs, and click any card to see fees, campus life, and official resources.
ProductTour.step_4_body: From application prep to visa support and arrival — see everything included in our free guidance.
ProductTour.step_5_body: These are verified stories from students who already made the journey — proof this actually works.
ProductTour.step_6_body: Check the FAQ for quick answers about costs, timelines, and eligibility.
ProductTour.step_7_body: Ready? Fill in the form or message us on WhatsApp — our team replies the same day.
